svg.title: MOSAIC Lab
svg.desc: Two complete visible loops with a quarter-loop extension at each end. A right-handed antiparallel DNA schematic with 14 base-pair bars. Bars are base pairs, not individual hydrogen bonds. No tagline.
svg.metadata: {"model": "schematic centerlines, not an atomic or chemical-bond diagram", "handedness": "right", "camera": "negative y", "screen_right": "+x", "screen_up": "+z", "nearer_depth": "-y", "helical_turns": 1.25, "visible_loop_span": 2.5, "base_pairs_per_full_helical_turn": 10.5, "base_pair_count": 14, "base_pair_center_rise_angstrom": 3.4, "rungs": "one connecting bar per base pair, not individual hydrogen bonds", "strand_polarity": ["5prime to 3prime with increasing z", "5prime to 3prime with decreasing z"], "backbone_phase_degrees": 144, "end_extensions_in_visible_loops": 0.25}
